entry.name: Skilluv
entry.body: A platform for learning through real software. Crimson lives only here, at display size: at 2.8 to 1 against the black it cannot carry running text without becoming unreadable.

world.title: The Kingdom of Salt and Iron
world.body: Violet cannot be ink. At 1.7 to 1 against the black it disappears. So it becomes the ground instead, and ivory writes on top of it at 10.2 to 1. The contrast measurement produced the rule, not taste.
